question.text: What is the requirement for a debenture trustee as per securities market regulations?

answer.text: A debenture trustee must apply to SEBI for grant of certificate to act as debenture trustee in the prescribed format
A debenture trustee is automatically appointed by the company issuing debentures with no regulatory approval needed
Only banks can act as debenture trustees and they need RBI approval
Debenture trustees are appointed by stock exchanges

explanation.text: The Logic: A debenture trustee is a trustee of a trust deed for securing any issue of debentures of a body corporate. An application for a grant of certificate to act as a debenture trustee must be made to SEBI in the prescribed format. The Trap: SEBI registration is mandatory — debenture trustees cannot operate without it. They are not limited to banks, and stock exchanges do not appoint them. Note: Source — NISM-Series-III-C workbook (January 2026), page 16 on the debenture trustee definition and the SEBI certificate application requirement.
